summary: Tested two critical bug fixes: (1) License Manager page now loads correctly with all data after Promise.all fix, (2) Login wizard no longer reappears on every navigation due to session flag fix. All requested features verified working.
critical_code_review_comments: LicenseManager.js: fetchData (lines 70-107) now uses independent try-catch blocks for each API call instead of Promise.all, allowing partial data to load even if one endpoint fails
App.js: LoginWizardWrapper (lines 373-413) now uses 'login_wizard_shown' sessionStorage flag to prevent re-showing wizard on navigation
AuthContext.js: logout function (lines 175-188) now clears sessionStorage flags (login_wizard_shown, show_login_wizard) ensuring wizard appears on next login
context_for_next_testing_agent: License Manager and Login Wizard bug fixes verified. License Manager loads all 3 tabs (Overview, Requests, Packages) with stats and data. Login wizard appears once after login and doesn't reappear during navigation.
